thread:
Hana (new-hire): hey all, day 1 here. using company M1 + WireGuard split-tunnel profile. ssh to bastion drops after ~8 minutes and git fails with "Could not resolve host". any quick tips?

Diego (infra): welcome! very common. do you have a ~/.ssh/config entry? also what WG DNS/AllowedIPs show (no secrets)?

Hana (new-hire): here's the host entry:

```
Host bastion-us-east
  HostName bastion.us-east-1.redwood
  User hana
  ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p jump.redwood
```
WG DNS blank, AllowedIPs 10.0.0.0/8.

Priya (it-support): on mac M1 the OS can flip DNS to the ISP if WG doesn't set it. two fast things: set the WireGuard DNS to 10.0.4.2 and switch ProxyCommand -> ProxyJump. add ServerAliveInterval 30 to ssh config.

Diego (infra): also run `ssh -vvv` next time and paste lines around the disconnect; "Connection reset by peer" usually means the TCP session was dropped (could be maintenance or NAT).

deploy-bot: notice: rolling reboot: bastion-us-east-2 will restart in 6m (maint-2026-11-07-2). Sessions on that host may drop.

Oncall Ops: confirming the rolling reboot. If you hit a disconnect during the window it may be the host reboot. Try `ssh bastion-us-east -J jump.redwood` to land on a different host.

Hana (new-hire): updated ssh config to ProxyJump + ServerAliveInterval and set WG DNS to 10.0.4.2. I still saw one drop exactly during the maintenance window but DNS errors stopped after forcing internal DNS.

Priya (it-support): great. I'll add a small onboarding note: "M1 macs + split-tunnel: force internal DNS and enable SSH keepalives; prefer ProxyJump." If it reappears ping me and I can pair.

Diego (infra): welcome aboard! if agent forwarding stops working after a reconnect run `ssh-add -l` and re-add keys. Happy to pair if you want. :tada:
